data.label: ABOUT ME jinku
title: CRAFTING
THE VOID
data.description: I'm a multidisciplinary designer exploring the intersection of minimalism, fashion, and digital art. Every project is an exercise in subtraction — stripping away the unnecessary until only the essential remains.

items.description:
Focused on interactive minimalism and spatial design.
Thesis on negative space in digital experiences.
Foundation in typography, branding, and visual systems. Graduated with first-class honours.
Exploratory year across fine art, photography, and communication design.

items.title: Minimalism & Accessibility

items.title: Materiality in Virtual Environments
items.description: Researching how digital textures and simulated materials influence emotional response in immersive 3D spaces.
